candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in inventory, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs; whether the timeout stems from Redis saturation, network, or config is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory propagating to order ReadTimeouts and gateway 502s on /v1/checkout; metrics show 16 502s and p95 ~2425ms on checkout. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server metrics (latency, connections, CPU) to confirm Redis-side saturation vs network cause
Inventory service logs for the reserve_inventory timeout window
Gateway logs (excluded from context) to corroborate 502 propagation
